external_study.title: Deep limit order book forecasting: a microstructural guide

data.split: per-year train/validation/test; test periods held out

operational_metric.name: pT
operational_metric.definition: probability that a transaction executed from the prediction sequence corresponds to a potential correct transaction in the target sequence
operational_metric.note: strategy-oriented, assumption-free operational practicability metric from the paper

independent_replication.note: Our public-data replication shows directional information conditional on non-stationary outcomes, but did not pass a strict actionable-signal gate.

current_ORCL_tests.source: Yahoo intraday OHLCV + existing ALANTU sentiment history
notes: Original Vorimpuls was approximately chance on 15/30m and negative by 60m.
Regime-relative, breakout, reversal, ignition and peer-pooled variants failed held-out robustness.

conclusion.reason: ORCL-specific published LOB evidence shows prediction metrics can improve while pT, the transaction-level correctness metric, remains low and collapses at high confidence; current ALANTU data has not produced stable held-out net edge.
